text: yes well.. the other thing is like, i could name the edges where it sits in, but there is no way to name an edge piece only faces
resolution: Established the missing semantic primitive: persistent named edge sets/loops, stored by canonical stable logical-vertex pairs rather than render triangle-edge indices. This lets an artist name a detached part perimeter (for example ps_rear_door.mount) and the receiving body seam (ps_rear_door.socket); Agent Seat can then solve and validate the rigid transform between those loops. Face semantics remain surfaces, while edge semantics represent seams, sockets, hinges, and attachment boundaries.
